newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end on high but gains limited.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end on high but gains limited.

text.p: 1620 GMT - Portuguese bonds ended a busy session higher in line with Italy and Spain but U.S. hourly earnings capped gains. *June 97 futures ended 1.00 point higher at 105.89. *Feb 07 cash 97.85 vs 97.34, yield 6.93 pct vs 7.00 pct *Spread vs Spanish 10-yr cash -13 bps vs -22 bps
